newsitem.title: POLAND: Court to decide on Stalexport tax June 19.
newsitem.headline: Court to decide on Stalexport tax June 19.

text.p: A court in Katowice will meet on June 19 to decide on Polish steel trader Stalexport SA's demand that the state treasury should pay it 52 million zlotys in damages, Stalexport said in a statement on Monday.
Stalexport is claiming the 52 million zlotys in damages for the three years it could not use funds from overpaid tax.
In 1993 Stalexport received a refund of tax it had overpaid in 1989 and 1990 because of exchange rate differences.

It also claimed 75 million zlotys in interest on the tax but a branch of the Supreme Administrative Court (NSA) ruled last year that the treasury did not have to refund the interest. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
